title: Representational drift in a code model: behaviour settles, which neurons carry it does not
abstract: arXiv:2611.09204v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In neuroscience, representational drift is a change in which neurons carry a representation while behaviour stays the same; we measure its analogue in OpenCoder-1.5B during pretraining, for 169 Python constructs over two trillion tokens at a constant learning rate, with a noise unit on every change, at checkpoints as close as 1,000 training steps. For 16 of the 169, those whose grammar fixes a next token, the loss at those positions reaches its floor within the first 4% of training, while the model's reliance on the neurons carrying them grows to the end: removing them costs 0.06, 0.25 and 0.40 nats more than removing a random set, at 4 billion, 84 billion and 2 trillion tokens. translated_title: 代码模型中的表征漂移：行为趋于定型，而承载它的神经元却未定型
translated_abstract: 在神经科学中，表征漂移是指在行为保持不变的情况下，承载某一表征的神经元发生改变；我们在OpenCoder-1.5B的预训练过程中测量了其类似现象，涵盖169个Python构造、2万亿个token，学习率保持恒定，每次变化都设有噪声单位，检查点间隔最短仅为1,000个训练步。对于169个构造中的16个——即其语法固定了下一个token的那些构造——这些位置上的损失在训练的前4%内就达到了最低值，而模型对承载这些构造的神经元的依赖却持续增长到训练结束：在40亿、840亿和2万亿token时，移除这些神经元比移除随机神经元集合分别多造成0.06、0.25和0.40 nats的损失。承载某一构造的神经元集合从未定型：对于全部169个构造，在最后一个检查点时承载集合仍在变化；若在840亿到1.5万亿token之间的任何时间点发生突然定型，或在5000亿token之前发生渐变定型，都能以99%的概率被检测到。
tldr: 该研究首次在代码大模型OpenCoder-1.5B的预训练中系统测量了神经科学中的“表征漂移”现象，发现对于语法固定的Python构造，模型行为（损失）在训练早期即已定型，但承载这些行为的神经元集合在整个训练过程中持续变化、从未稳定。
en_tdlr: This study systematically measures the neuroscience concept of representational drift in OpenCoder-1.5B during pretraining, showing that while behavior (loss) on grammatically-fixed Python constructs settles early in training, the sets of neurons carrying them keep changing throughout training and never stabilize.
